objective: Search the library by title from the dashboard.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Add a search form to the dashboard that submits a GET request with the parameter q and shows the current search in the input.

Create src/lib/library-search.ts exporting LIBRARY_SEARCH_MAX_LENGTH (100), normalizeLibrarySearch(raw), filterLibraryItemsByTitle(rows, query) and libraryPageHref({ q, cursor, direction }) exactly as specified in the acceptance test header.

The dashboard must normalize q with normalizeLibrarySearch, filter the owner's rows with filterLibraryItemsByTitle before calling the existing paginateLibraryItems, and build every Older and Newer link with libraryPageHref so paging keeps the active search.
An invalid search (normalizeLibrarySearch returns null) shows a clear invalid-search message instead of results; it is not reported as a library read error.
When a search matches nothing, show a no-matches message with a link that clears the search.
Preserve authenticated owner filtering, existing pagination behavior, the distinct read-error state, and existing upload and draft-review behavior.
acceptance_tests_note: Factory-owned tests run unchanged in the sandbox after the repository checks; the builder cannot edit them and must make them pass.
source_manifest_note: Computed by the coding assistant from a separate read-only clone with both the Factory reader and the owner's standalone script (104 files, 669861 bytes); the Factory fetch verifies it independently before use.
